data.name: Regenesis Arcade
data.detailed_description:
ERADICATE MACHINES. SAVE EARTH.
Jump into the middle of the action in Regenesis Arcade, the VR sci-fi shooter set in dystopian future ran by machines. Select one of two locomotion modes (free movement or teleport) and choose from variety of weapons, one for each hand, creating powerful synergies using perks to take the fight to machines.

Most of game’s content will be a bit different every time you play due to a random generation mechanism.

WEAPONS & UPGRADES: INSTRUMENTS OF DESTRUCTION
Collect weapons from each of three categories, that can be upgraded for maximized firepower. From gravity gun, through minigun, shotgun to powerful rocket launcher and wavegun, every weapon comes with its own strengths and weaknesses you need to consider while in the heat of the combat.

KNOW YOUR ENEMY
Fighting the deadly killing machines will not be easy. Coming from all directions, covering both ground and air, each enemy requires different tactical approach. Some will activate shields that either deflect or absorb damage, others will dodge swiftly every shot coming at them or make a kamikaze run right into your face. Do not underestimate your opponent no matter how small it might be!

THE WAR THEATER
In Regenesis Arcade, you will battle through 8 detailed maps in campaign mode, ranging from futuristic cities, through forests to atomic wastelands, in different weather conditions, including a snowy blizzard!

Discover and explore each map’s enemies and weapons drops in order to gain tactical advantage! After you finish the campaign you will continue in game+ mode, that will increase the difficulty and enable all types of enemies and unique weapons to be spawned in each level.

After you unlock a level, you can start campaign from any point you want, getting faster to the further part of the game but not having all the goodies you might have collected if you’d start from the beginning. It’s up to you to either save your time grinding or prepare yourself better for the onslaught!


GLOBAL SCOREBOARD
Feel the spirit of ARCADE competition and fight for the highest score on the global leaderboard! Random generation and long-run nature of the game encourages you to master the levels and the weapons to the point where you can effectively compete for the domination as the ultimate champion without getting bored.

Regenesis Arcade brings the true spirit of retro arcade games into modern environment of Virtual Reality!

reviews.review:
[h1] Experienced on the Oculus Rift with Touch Controllers [/h1]

Very close call on whether to recommend or not, but I'm voting No. This is another wave shooter, there's nothing wrong with that, I just don't think this game adds enough to the equation to be asking for $14.99 normal price or even the $8.99 Steam summer sale price.

There are 6 maps okay. But the first variation you see after finishing the first map, is the same map, only it's nighttime. That's not really a good way to impress new players. The only new enemy introduced is little bug robots. I think they add a turret upgrade as well. The difficulty spike from the first map to the second is quite jarring. You have to start at the very beginning of the wave if you die more than 3 times. You have to finish the 10 waves to unlock the next map.

You have 3 guns and several upgrades along the way. You have a blaster shooter gun, a shotgun, and a plasma rifle. You also have a shield or a gravity gun. I found the shield to be almost useless because you need the gravity gun against the many shielded drone enemies. All the guns feel like nerf guns. There are upgrades along the way to make each gun more useful. But it does take a long time to upgrade the weapon and you don't always get the upgrade you want. So bullets come out and they shoot slow, bullets go slow, reloads are slow, you sometimes have to empty your whole clip at close range to kill 1 drone. Meanwhile, there's several flying above you and many are shielded.

So what ends up happening, is that you have to teleport aimlessly. Sure you can point the direction that you want to teleport, but if you teleport that carefully you probably won't last long. You just have to teleport as quickly as possible and then shoot quickly and then teleport again. This is all teleporting within a confined area with many obstacles in the way where you can't teleport. The best strategy, especially with shielded drones, is to teleport and wave your gravity gun with an object attached and hope you hit the shielded drone. Pray you don't get hit too much.

The sad thing is that there's some very fun elements to this game. There's some good boss fights. The upgrades are good. Your gravity gun has some unique skills like catching bullets. But all that is detracted by the very basic enemy design and core gameplay. There's just more fun wave shooters at this price point.

Rate 4/10. This should be a $4.99 game honestly, it's not $14.99 quality.
reviews.developer_response:
Hey,

Thank you so much for tons of valuable feedback and clues on how to improve the experience. We are glad to hear honest review like that, makes us really think about lots of the big and small details of the game and all that is related to it. We really wish more review would be as detailed as that.

Your review encouraged us even more to come up with a massive update that hopefully is going to change your opinnion a lots, since many elements you mentioned in this review have been revisited and improved, making it by far the best Regenesis Arcade experience ever. Please, let us know how you like the new face of our game.

Thank you so much and again, we encourage you to take one more look.

Cheers!
